title: DAPI Staining
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Obtain protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle from the Opentrons site and, if required, upload any custom labware definitions before loading the protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck and calibrate
steps.instruction: Load an empty waste reservoir, a 12‑channel reagent reservoir, tip racks, and the eppendorf plate(s) onto the deck as shown in the deck map; attach the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette to the left mount, then calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate labware, tip racks, and pipette in OT App

steps.title: Process each plate (up to 4)
steps.instruction: For each plate, execute the following liquid‑handling sequence.

steps.title: Remove media
steps.instruction: Aspirate 120 µL of culture media from each well and dispense it into the waste reservoir.

steps.title: Two PBS washes
steps.instruction: Add 140 µL PBS to each well, remove 140 µL to waste, then add another 140 µL PBS and remove 140 µL again.

steps.title: Fix with PFA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 2 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) to each well, pause for the required fixation time, then remove 100 µL of 2 % PFA and discard to waste.

steps.title: DAPI staining
steps.instruction: Add 140 µL of PBS containing DAPI to each well, then remove 140 µL of the PBS‑DAPI solution to waste.

steps.title: Final PBS washes
steps.instruction: Add 140 µL PBS to each well, remove 140 µL to waste, then add a final 140 µL PBS to each well.

steps.title: Execute protocol on OT‑2
steps.instruction: Upload the prepared protocol file to the OT App, select the appropriate deck map, and press “Run” to start the automated DAPI staining.
